service.description: Check every "when" line of one rule and turn them into Moqui conditions. Each line is prepared by the service its RuleConditionType names, lines under it first. A top line must read exactly one fact type, one the decision reads directly, and a rule reads at most 3 fact types. Used by store#Rule and by the decision builder.

parameter.name: ruleSetId
parameter.description: The decision whose fact types the lines are checked against. Not needed when readFactTypeIds is given.

parameter.name: conditions
parameter.description: Maps of conditionSeqId, parentConditionSeqId, sequenceNum, conditionTypeId, factTypeId, fieldName, operatorEnumId, compareValue, compareFieldName and tolerance.

parameter.name: readFactTypeIds
parameter.description: Check against these fact types instead of a decision's.

parameter.name: directFactTypeIds
parameter.description: With readFactTypeIds: the ones a top line may read.

parameter.name: pieceChain
parameter.description: The pieces being expanded, outermost first, to refuse a piece that uses itself and nesting past 3 levels.

parameter.name: savedRows
parameter.description: The lines to save, parents first, numbered in order.

parameter.name: topLines
parameter.description: What each top line gave, in order.

parameter.name: factMatches
parameter.description: For each fact type the rule reads, a map of condition and itemChecks that a fact must match. Empty when there are problems.

if.script: problems.add("Each condition needs a conditionSeqId")

iterate.script: problems.add("Condition ${unplacedRow.conditionSeqId} of rule ${ruleName}: its parent ${unplacedRow.parentConditionSeqId} is not a line of this rule".toString())

set.from: [problems: ['condition type ' + row.conditionTypeId + ' is not known'], factTypeIds: []]

service-call.name: ${conditionType.prepareServiceName}
service-call.in-map: [line: row, childLines: childLines, readFactTypeIds: readFactTypeIds, pieceChain: pieceChain ?: []]

iterate.script: preparedBySeqId.put(row.conditionSeqId, prepared + [conditionSeqId: row.conditionSeqId, row: row, children: childLines]) problems.addAll(prepared.problems.collect { "Condition ${row.conditionSeqId} of rule ${ruleName}: ${it}".toString() })

if.script: problems.add("Condition ${topLine.conditionSeqId} of rule ${ruleName}: the lines under a group must read exactly one fact type".toString())

else-if.script: problems.add("Condition ${topLine.conditionSeqId} of rule ${ruleName}: ${topLine.factTypeIds[0]} is a list item type, so its lines must sit under an exists line".toString())

if.script: problems.add("Rule ${ruleName}: a rule reads at most 3 fact types".toString())

set.from: walkOrder.collect { [conditionSeqId: it.conditionSeqId, parentConditionSeqId: it.parentConditionSeqId, sequenceNum: rows.indexOf(it) + 1, conditionTypeId: it.conditionTypeId, factTypeId: it.factTypeId, fieldName: it.fieldName, operatorEnumId: it.operatorEnumId, compareValue: it.compareValue as String, compareFieldName: it.compareFieldName, tolerance: it.tolerance] }

topLines.groupBy { it.factTypeIds[0] }.collectEntries { factTypeId, factLines -> [(factTypeId): [condition: ec.entity.conditionFactory.makeCondition(factLines*.matches*.condition, org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.AND), itemChecks: factLines.collectMany { it.matches.itemChecks }, valueChecks: factLines.collectMany { it.matches.valueChecks ?: [] }]] }

service.description: Use a named piece: compareValue holds the pieceId. The piece's own lines are prepared the way a rule's are, against the fact types the decision reads, and give their AND as this one line. A piece that uses itself, or nests past 3 levels, is refused.

parameter.name: innerLines
parameter.description: What each top line of the piece gave, for explain#RuleSet.

if.script: problems.add("a piece line takes no lines under it")
problems.add("piece ${pieceId} uses itself: ${(chain.subList(chain.indexOf(pieceId), chain.size()) + [pieceId]).join(' > ')}".toString())
problems.add("piece ${pieceId} is nested more than 3 levels deep: ${(chain + [pieceId]).join(' > ')}".toString())
problems.add("piece ${pieceId} does not exist".toString())
problems.add("the decision does not read ${piece.factTypeId}, which piece ${pieceId} is over".toString())

service-call.name: moqui.rules.RuleLineServices.prepare#RuleLines
service-call.in-map: [ruleName: 'piece ' + pieceId, conditions: pieceLines.collect { it.getMap() }, readFactTypeIds: readFactTypeIds, directFactTypeIds: [piece.factTypeId], pieceChain: chain + [pieceId]]

if.script: problems.add("piece ${pieceId} has no lines".toString())
problems.add("piece ${pieceId} has lines that read a fact type other than ${piece.factTypeId}".toString())

set.from: [condition: conditionFactory.makeCondition(inner*.matches*.condition, org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.AND), itemChecks: inner.collectMany { it.matches.itemChecks }, valueChecks: inner.collectMany { it.matches.valueChecks ?: [] }]

service.description: Check one "when" line and turn it into a Moqui condition, as written and turned around. Each RuleConditionType names the service for its kind in prepareServiceName. A line with problems gives no conditions.

parameter.name: line
parameter.description: conditionSeqId, conditionTypeId, factTypeId, fieldName, operatorEnumId and compareValue.

parameter.name: childLines
parameter.description: What this service gave for each line directly under it.

parameter.name: readFactTypeIds
parameter.description: The fact types the decision reads, list item types included.

parameter.name: pieceChain
parameter.description: The pieces being expanded around this line, outermost first.

parameter.name: valueTypeEnumId
parameter.description: Check as if the field held this kind of value, for a field whose kind is being changed.

parameter.name: factTypeIds
parameter.description: The fact types the line reads.

parameter.name: matches
parameter.description: condition, an EntityCondition on the fact's own fields, and itemChecks, a list of maps of fieldName, itemMatch and found for exists lines.

parameter.name: notMatches
parameter.description: The line turned around, in the same shape. Empty when the line cannot be turned around.

set.from: [ENTCO_EQUALS: 'ENTCO_NOT_EQUALS', ENTCO_NOT_EQUALS: 'ENTCO_EQUALS', ENTCO_LESS: 'ENTCO_GREATER_EQ', ENTCO_GREATER_EQ: 'ENTCO_LESS', ENTCO_GREATER: 'ENTCO_LESS_EQ', ENTCO_LESS_EQ: 'ENTCO_GREATER', ENTCO_LIKE: 'ENTCO_NOT_LIKE', ENTCO_NOT_LIKE: 'ENTCO_LIKE', ENTCO_IS_NULL: 'ENTCO_IS_NOT_NULL', ENTCO_IS_NOT_NULL: 'ENTCO_IS_NULL']

if.script: problems.add("a compare line takes no lines under it")
problems.add("the decision does not read field ${line.fieldName} of ${line.factTypeId}".toString())
problems.add("operator ${line.operatorEnumId} is not allowed".toString())
problems.add("list field ${line.fieldName} cannot be compared, use an exists line".toString())
problems.add("operator ${line.operatorEnumId} works on text fields only".toString())
problems.add("value ${line.compareValue} does not fit field ${line.fieldName}".toString())

service.description: Compare one field of a fact with another field of the same fact. Every operator is a value check, evaluated by the value-check truth table (a tolerance of 0 is plain equality).

set.from: [FPO_REQUIRES: 'requires', FPO_REQUIRED_BY: 'required by', FPO_ALL_IN: 'all in', FPO_CONTAINS_ALL: 'contains all', ENTCO_EQUALS: '=', ENTCO_NOT_EQUALS: '!=', ENTCO_LESS: '<', ENTCO_GREATER: '>', ENTCO_LESS_EQ: '<=', ENTCO_GREATER_EQ: '>=']

if.script: problems.add("a compare two fields line takes no lines under it")
problems.add("operator ${line.operatorEnumId} is not allowed".toString())
problems.add("the decision does not read field ${oneFieldName} of ${line.factTypeId}".toString())

else-if.script: problems.add("list field ${oneFieldName} cannot be compared, use an exists line".toString())

if.script: problems.add("tolerance ${line.tolerance} is not a number".toString())

else-if.script: problems.add("a tolerance only goes with the equals operator".toString())

set.from: [kind: hasTolerance ? 'equals within' : pairKinds.get(line.operatorEnumId), fieldName: line.fieldName, compareFieldName: line.compareFieldName, tolerance: hasTolerance ? toleranceNumber : null]

if.script: problems.add("an all line needs at least one line under it")

set.from: [condition: conditionFactory.makeCondition(childLines*.matches*.condition, org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.AND), itemChecks: childLines.collectMany { it.matches.itemChecks }, valueChecks: childLines.collectMany { it.matches.valueChecks ?: [] }]

if.script: problems.add("an any line needs at least one line under it")
problems.add("an exists line cannot be one choice of an any line, write a second rule instead")
problems.add("a compare-two-fields line cannot be one choice of an any line, write a second rule instead")

set.from: [condition: conditionFactory.makeCondition(childLines*.notMatches*.condition, org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.AND), itemChecks: childLines.collectMany { it.notMatches.itemChecks }, valueChecks: childLines.collectMany { it.notMatches.valueChecks ?: [] }]

if.script: problems.add("a not line needs at least one line under it")

iterate.script: problems.add("line ${unturnableLine.conditionSeqId} cannot be turned around under a not line".toString())

set.from: [condition: conditionFactory.makeCondition(childLines*.notMatches*.condition, org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.AND), itemChecks: childLines.collectMany { it.notMatches.itemChecks }, valueChecks: childLines.collectMany { it.notMatches.valueChecks ?: [] }]

if.script: problems.add("${line.fieldName} of ${line.factTypeId} is not a list field the decision reads".toString())
problems.add("the lines under it must read ${factField.itemFactTypeId}, the item type of ${line.fieldName}".toString())

set.from: [condition: conditionFactory.makeCondition(lines*.matches*.condition, org.moqui.entity.EntityCondition.AND), itemChecks: lines.collectMany { it.matches.itemChecks }, valueChecks: lines.collectMany { it.matches.valueChecks ?: [] }]
[condition: conditionFactory.trueCondition, itemChecks: [[fieldName: line.fieldName, itemMatch: itemMatch, found: true]], valueChecks: []]
[condition: conditionFactory.trueCondition, itemChecks: [[fieldName: line.fieldName, itemMatch: itemMatch, found: false]], valueChecks: []]
